canonical_mining_transition.interpretation: Mining switches the shaping objective and public observation to return mode without terminating or masking the transition.

learning_and_scoring_contract.learning_contract_scope: The mask fields describe the fixed PPO implementation at the recorded source hashes; they are not an independent measurement from checkpoint tensors.

craft_ready_seed40_unqualified.canonical_post_mine_mode: DO for all 255 active steps at the target pose, then timeout

craft_ready_seed41_unqualified.canonical_post_mine_mode: DOWN for all 255 active steps; stops progressing at position [14, 26], then timeout

target_ready_seed42_unqualified.phase_start_mode: DO for all 255 post-mine active steps at the target pose, then timeout

conclusion.tested_implementation_fault_scope: Goal switching and observation changes at mining, PPO terminal masking, success/return/terminal agreement, camp-adjacency classification, and frozen learner-state immutability.
conclusion.primary_observed_failure: Frozen failed policies usually do not execute a return route after mining; their modal behavior loops on DO or one blocked movement direction until timeout.
conclusion.secondary_observed_failure: In target-ready seed 42 stochastic evaluation, 9 of 126 failed episodes reached a legal camp-adjacent return position but did not take a legal RETURN_TARGET action.
conclusion.horizon_interpretation: Failures terminate at the 256-tick horizon. Across the three unqualified phase-start samples, observed mining left 109 to 255 ticks; the canonical post-mine state has task distance 47. This makes immediate horizon exhaustion at mining implausible, but does not prove the horizon is irrelevant to inefficient trajectories.
conclusion.sampling_limit: The 128 sample episodes per frozen checkpoint are evaluation replications, not independent training seeds. Common episode action-draw keys are reused across policies within each start, so counts such as 128/128 are not seed replication.
conclusion.claim_limit: This supports a return-navigation and occasional final-action learning failure in these frozen policies. It does not establish a unique underlying optimization cause or explain the entire natural-start failure.
